content: उत्क्रम् €1 <ab>U.</ab> €4 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To go up, step up, ascend; उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि <ls>Bg. 15. 10</ls>. .²2 To step beyond; उत्क्रान्तशैशवौ <ls>R. 15. 33</ls>; past childhood. .²3 To step out, go out or away, depart; ऊर्ध्वं प्राणा ह्युत्कामन्ति <ls>Ms. 2. 120</ls>; <ls>Mv. 1</ls>. .²4 To pass away, die; यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः <ls>Bg. 15. 8</ls>. .²5 To go or pass over, omit. .²6 To disregard, not to notice, neglect; आर्षं प्रमाणमुत्क्रम्य, धर्ममुत्क्रम्य <ls>Mb.</ls> .²7 To transgress, violate; उत्क्रान्तसीमा <ls>Dk. 101</ls>, <ls n="Dk.">97</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (क्रामयति) To cause to go up or ascend.
